changelog: Voice-emoji names gain 18 more everyday emoji: say "heart eyes emoji" / "bangladesh flag emoji" / "birthday cake emoji" (or "প্রেম চোখ ইমোজি" / "বাংলাদেশের পতাকা ইমোজি" / "জন্মদিনের কেক ইমোজি") while dictating in WhatsApp/Messenger and the emoji inserts — the most-used WhatsApp names the old list missed (heart eyes, rolling-laughing, loudly crying, waving hand, hundred points, sparkles, blowing a kiss, birthday cake, raising hands, grinning, slight smile, thumbs down, hugging, angel, partying) plus the Bangladesh flag.
